g.text: (e) A sentence before the lockers: the lookup's identity share, whole change
V0 nothing · V1 a pick naming the first-locker item · V2 a pick naming another locker item ·
V3 a pick naming an item with no locker · V4 a neutral sentence. After the data; dashed: V0. 95% CI.
